documentation.content: Cloud Run `stratum-solver` p99 request latency exceeded 120s over 10 min (built-in metric `run.googleapis.com/request_latencies`, a DISTRIBUTION measured in **milliseconds** -- `thresholdValue` below is `120000`, i.e. 120s). 120s is the CP-SAT deadline; sustained p99 above it means solves are timing out against the 180s request timeout. Triage: Cloud Run logs for the service, check CPU throttling and cold starts (min-instances=0). Context: STR-24, `docs/cloud-program-synthesis-deploy.md` operational constants.
